component.name: PanePilot
component.summary: Two-panel file manager inspired by FreeCommander
Zwei-Fenster-Dateimanager nach dem Vorbild von FreeCommander

description.p: PanePilot is a free two-panel file manager for Linux, inspired by FreeCommander. It combines tools that usually require several separate programs in one application.

ul.li: Two panels with folder tree, nested favourites and a drive overview
FTP and SFTP client with server list, transfer queue and import from FileZilla
Search by file name and content
Multi-rename with placeholders, counters, dates, regular expressions, preview and undo
Meta wizard for music tags with covers, converters, MusicBrainz lookup, CSV import and export, playlists and ReplayGain
Photo metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) with preview, date shift and renaming by date taken
Video metadata (MP4, MOV, WMV, MKV) with thumbnail, duration, resolution and codecs
Checksums with comparison and drag and drop of checksum files
Configurable keyboard shortcuts, function-key bar and toolbar

description.p: Videos whose file extension does not match their content (e.g. an MKV video named .mp4) are now read correctly in the meta wizard.
The "Metadata" tab in the file properties now also shows photo and video metadata.

Video metadata in the meta wizard: MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP and WMV (MKV/WebM with mkvtoolnix, AVI and MTS read-only), thumbnail or still frame, duration, resolution and codecs, date shift and GPS removal; new help chapter on additional programs.
Photo metadata in the meta wizard: EXIF, IPTC and XMP for JPEG, PNG, TIFF and WebP (HEIC with exiftool, RAW read-only), preview, GPS removal, date shift and renaming by date taken.
Fixes waiting windows that stayed open after connecting to a server; "Server" is now called "FTP server".
FTP/SFTP client: servers in a sidebar, FTP, FTP over TLS and SFTP in the normal file panel, transfer queue, passwords in the system keyring and import from FileZilla.
MusicBrainz lookup and disc numbering in the meta wizard, optional update check, Upper Saxon as seventh language.
Open terminal here, directory listings as text file, UI scaling, application-menu entry and update information for AppImageUpdate.
Packaging: AppStream metadata and an English desktop entry for software centers and AppImageHub.
